description: This PHP source file defines functions related to layer styles, including capabilities detection, JavaScript code generation for animated layers, and HTML output for layers in an ad server context.

methods.name: MAX_layerGetLimitations
methods.description: Returns capabilities such as rich media support and browser compatibility based on client agent info.

methods.name: MAX_layerPutJs
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for animated layer behavior, including grow and move animations.

methods.name: MAX_layerGetHtml
methods.description: Returns HTML code for rendering a layer with specified styles and content.
